en.title: Fluffy Rabbit's Letter Delivery and the Sky Lighthouse
en.premise: Mimi is a rabbit who makes her living delivering letters. One day, she discovers a mysterious old letter with a vanished address. Boarding a flying ship, Mimi sets off on a journey toward the 'Sky Lighthouse'—a place where forgotten feelings gather. A gentle tale of her quest to find the letter's owner, as she forms heartwarming bonds with the animals she meets along the way.

zh.title: 软绵绵的小兔与天空灯塔
zh.premise: 小兔子米米（Mimi）的工作是投递信件。某一天，她捡到了一封地址消失了的神奇旧信。米米乘着飞空船，朝着汇聚着被遗忘思念的“天空灯塔”踏上了旅程。这是一个在寻找信件主人的过程中，与途中遇到的动物们交流心灵、温暖治愈的故事。
